definition.reached: Body COM xy of body_link finishes inside that room's floor box from room_apartment.json, the bout started with that COM outside the same box, min up_z is at least 0.90, prop contacts are zero, and the bout ends at or before 53.0 s. A start inside the box is not a reach. The plant floor from -3 m to +3 m is not the box.
definition.floor_box: The named room floor_box in mujoco/room_apartment.json. It is not a geom and it is not passed to a command.
definition.prop_contact: A contact with normal force >= 0.5 N between a robot geom and any geom other than floor.
definition.d_min: d_min = 0.150 * (T_detect + T_stop). 0.150 is the hardware bound in that formula, not the voice vx cap. T_detect = 0.000 s. T_stop = 0.842 s.
definition.false_stop: A #71 stop whose floor point lies on the speckled shadow patch in front of the kitchen or bathroom doorway, with no furniture prop in the kit_cam frame. That stop is not a #71 pass. Walls are not props.
definition.yes_no: Per asked room: 'Is there a {room} through the doorway ahead?' yes or no. Not an open-set room name. Moondream yes is logged against the 1% kit_cam gate. A yes under that fraction is refused and the search continues. It does not publish forward vel. A yes under that fraction that still commits forward vel is a wrong yes.
definition.search: Spawn yaw is the door-facing yaw plus or minus 90 degrees. After the stand, vel(0, +0.25) turns in place. No forward vel until a correct yes. Every 20 degrees the turn stops (yaw 0) and the body settles for 0.70 s. The room question is asked only when the doorway opening is actually in kit_cam. Otherwise the body turns in place at yaw +0.25, and that applied yaw is logged on the search. The picture is still taken after yaw has settled to 0. Moondream detects a doorway pixel only on that gated frame. The logged heading is the heading at capture, not the heading when the answer returns. The search turn sign is not taken from the door bearing. A correct yes yaws in place toward the doorway pixel, settles until applied yaw is 0, then walks at +0.056 m/s with yaw 0. Yaw is not commanded while walking. It re-points the same way after each 1.00 s stop-settle-capture. kit_cam is not moved. A floor/wall image row is ranged with the live camera. The floor-edge latch fires only when the forward ray hits a wall. A prop hit is logged and is not added to the latch. Every real-wall ray logs the ranged gap, the sim gap, camera height, camera pitch, and the leading toe. A wall range more than 0.01 m off the sim gap, past the bob pad measured before the bouts, is not a wall-stop pass. One bout's wall error is not added to the latch. The same bias above 0.03 m must repeat on a real-wall ray with that log before it could be added, and a repeat still fails this measure. In-place body yaw that asks a hip roll over 2.33 Nm unclamped is not a free re-point. d_min is not rebuilt. The ray uses the live camera height and the IMU pitch plus head_tilt, not a standing-pose table.
